content: Minara Strategy Studio: NL thesis -> structured strategy spec; template library (momentum, mean-reversion, arb, pairs); 10+ yrs minute data backtest with fees/funding/borrow/venue slippage curves; claims walk-forward, out-of-sample, regime-sliced views and automatic leakage detection; paper trading on the same engine as live with identical fee/slippage models; one-click promote to Autopilot; risk views: rolling max drawdown, volatility cone, exposure map by asset/sector/chain, concentration risk. Free to use. Direct competitor on the validation-honesty positioning.
